str_raw_analysis_info:
Process the raw data by running the station's currently selected model.
The detections are added to the chosen location; a new one named as the session is the default.
Move it to its final location after validation ({link}).
The analysis runs at the lowest priority and the live recording keeps going; no notifications, no upload.
str_raw_analysis_running: This session is already being analysed
str_raw_analysis_started: Analysis started: the detections go to the location {name}
str_raw_dir_help: Folder of the raw recordings ({menu:Raw Recording}); empty = ~/raw-recording; a mounted drive or network share may be chosen.
str_raw_dir_info: By default {dir}, on the card. Another folder can be a mounted USB drive or network share (e.g. the NAS): the station user must be able to write in it, and a session does not start when its drive or share is not mounted (nothing is written to the card instead).
str_raw_dir_not_found: Folder not found: {dir} (the folder is kept as it was)
str_raw_dir_not_writable: The station cannot write in {dir} (the folder is kept as it was)
str_raw_groups_info:
One group per microphone plugged in, the station's first.
Each has its own schedule, folder and sample rate, and its own sessions.
Two microphones can record at the same time while the station keeps running in parallel = Model + 2 RAWs.
str_raw_not_saved: The settings could not be saved
str_raw_not_started: The recording did not start (folder or microphone missing: see the system log)
str_raw_rate_help: Sample rate of the raw recordings in Hz ({menu:Raw Recording}); the shared device converts from the microphone's rate, at most the microphone's own rate.
str_raw_rate_info: It may differ from the station's: the analysis always records at 48 kHz, and the shared device converts the raw recording to the rate chosen here. A lower rate makes smaller files and keeps sounds up to half of it (24 kHz: up to 12 kHz); a rate above the microphone's own adds nothing, so it is not offered.
str_raw_rate_info_own: A lower rate makes smaller files and keeps sounds up to half of it (24 kHz: up to 12 kHz); a rate above the microphone's own adds nothing, so it is not offered.
str_raw_recordings_are_not_deleted_disk_: Raw recordings are not deleted automatically; keep an eye on the disk space:
str_raw_recordings_folder_help: The recordings are saved in {dir} (the Folder above), one subfolder per session (its start, the station's name and the microphone) with its WAV files and the session log. Click a session to see its files; a file opens in the browser.

str_remove_the_station_from_the_list: Remove the station "{name}" from the list?
str_removed_detections_out_of_the_help: Removed detections: out of the statistics, restorable until purged
str_removing_a_detection_takes_it_help: Removing a detection takes it out of the lists and statistics and moves the sound to the Removed folder.
str_restart_the_core_services_help: Restart the core services? Recording and analysis pause for about a minute.
str_restart_the_setup_help: The guide again with everything filled in: go through it as it is, or change what you want. Notifications keep going until you save.
str_restore_the_settings_from_the_help: Restore the settings from {file}? The current settings are replaced.
str_restore_them_or_purge_them_in_help: Restore them or purge them in {menu:Data} first, then remove it.
str_save_sends_a_test_e_mail_to_the_help: Save sends a test e-mail to the address above.
str_save_sends_a_test_message_to_help: Save sends a test message to each group.
str_saved_the_list_at_the_top_is_help: Saved; the list at the top is updated
str_saves_the_settings_then_sets_help: Saves the settings, then sets every setting to its factory default (name, coordinates, passwords, network and language stay).
str_scan_the_first_qr_with_the_help: Scan the first QR with the phone camera to join the station WiFi, then the second to open the page.
str_scan_the_qr_with_the_phone_the_help: Scan the QR with the phone; the station page opens.
str_see_the_address_under_connected_help: see the address under "connected devices" of the hotspot.
str_select_the_folder_that_holds_help: Select the folder that holds the backup to restore.
str_send_a_test_and_answer_when_it_help: Send a test and answer when it arrives.
str_send_start_in_the_group_the_help: Send /start@{user} in the group: the station sees it in a few seconds.
str_set_it_up_from_zero_with_the_help: Set it up from zero with the guide
str_set_it_up_when_the_station_is_help: Set it up when the station is not on a network through a cable.
str_settings_species_lists_help: Settings, species lists, notifications, locations and themes, without the detections (those go by Export / Backup).
str_shut_down_the_station_help: Shut the station down now? Wait for the green light to stop before taking the power away.
str_smallest_disk_that_fits_the_help: Smallest disk that fits: the smallest of 32 GB to 2 TB whose usable space (93%) keeps the peak under the purge limit of {p}%.
str_sounds_with_the_lock_confirmed_help: Sounds with the lock, confirmed "Yes", marked Review later and the {n} best of each species are never deleted by any limit.
str_species_with_clips_kept_plus_help: species with clips kept + {p}% for other seasons
str_stop_the_core_services_help: Stop the core services? Recording and analysis stop until they are started again.
str_telegram_is_already_set_up_help: Telegram is already set up: Remove only if it stopped working; then set it up again with the steps that appear.
str_telegram_notifications_stop: Telegram notifications stop until a bot is set up again.
str_test_sent_check_the_inbox_and_help: Test sent: check the inbox (and the spam folder)
str_that_network_is_tried_again_help: That network is tried again after 2, 4 and 8 minutes, then every 10 minutes on the clock (14:20, 14:30).
str_the_answers_human_noise_or_help: The answers Human, Noise or Ignore keep the detection in the database.
str_the_bot_must_be_a_member_of_the_help: The bot must be a member of the group.
str_the_clips_stop_growing_once_the_help: The clips stop growing once the species reach their limit; the database never stops (detections are never purged), so more years mean more database.
str_the_days_clips_before_the_help: The day's clips before the nightly purge
str_the_days_clips_before_the_purge_help: The day's clips before the purge follow the detections a day.
str_the_detections_get_a_clip_and_a_help: The detections get a clip and a sonogram like the live ones (EXT in the name), filed under that location; no notification, no upload.
str_the_disk_is_measured_every_5_help: The disk is measured every 5 minutes and around the nightly purge; the first day shows tomorrow.
str_the_e_mail_server_did_not_help: The e-mail server did not answer: {detail}.
str_the_e_mail_server_refused_the_help: The e-mail server refused the user or the password ({detail}).
str_the_external_backup_is_not_help: The external backup is not possible now:
str_the_file_copies_this_stations_help: The file birdnet-setup.conf takes this station's settings to new cards: location, time zone, model, species names and list, several locations or stations, and the passwords chosen below.
str_the_folder_below_must_be_help: the folder below must be reachable from that station too (e.g. the NAS)
str_the_journal_never_passes_200_mb_help: The journal never passes 200 MB (1 GB for a year or manual) and the rotated log files are compressed; the station's own logs rotate by themselves.
str_the_kiosk_is_off_turn_it_on_in_help: The Kiosk is off. Turn it on in {menu:All settings} › Other (ACTIVATE_KIOSK).
str_the_limit_per_species_leaves_help: The limit per species leaves the sounds of these days untouched.
str_the_list_is_saved_the_station_help: The list is saved, the station name not: {reason}
str_the_list_of_stations_can_also_help: The list of stations can also be synced with another station in:
str_the_location_model_of_that_help: The location model of that place and the week of each file decide which species are expected; nothing enters the station's base.
str_the_logs_could_not_be_cleaned: The logs could not be cleaned
str_the_map_could_not_be_loaded: The map could not be loaded.
str_the_notification_box_of_help: The notification box of Settings has its own e-mail line, which is kept as it is.
str_the_notification_boxes_of_help: The notification boxes of Settings also have Telegram lines set by hand; they are kept as they are.
str_the_notifications_still_work_help: The notifications still work: type the group ids below.
str_the_old_sounds_are_moved_here_help: The old sounds are moved here; their detections stay in the database.
str_the_peak_stays_under_the_ceiling: The peak stays under the ceiling
str_the_purge_limit_of_pct_is_help: The purge limit of {p}% is reached in about {n} days; from then on the oldest clips are purged.
str_the_ram_drive_is_pct_full: {pct} % full: the recordings waiting fill the RAM drive (the analysis is behind)
str_the_record_goes_to_the_database_help: The record goes to the database, and it is the record that counts in the statistics.
str_the_smtp_server_of_your_help: The SMTP server of your provider or organisation.
str_the_sound_is_deleted_help: The sound goes to the Purge folder and is deleted by itself after {days} days, or at once with Purge Ignored.
str_the_sound_stays_there_help: The sound goes to the Purge folder and stays there, no time limit, until Purge Ignored (IGNORED_PURGE_DAYS = 0).
str_the_station_cannot_write_in_help: The station cannot write in this folder
str_the_station_does_not_answer_if_help: The station does not answer. If you reach it over WiFi, its own WiFi may be on: join BirdSuite-XXXX with the phone, or wait until it turns off (30 minutes without a phone).
str_the_station_is_recording_stop_help: The station is recording: stop the recording before changing the location
str_the_station_mount_it_help: The station user cannot read this folder: mount it with read access for that user (e.g. uid= / file_mode= in /etc/fstab)
str_the_station_the_results_help: The station cannot write in this folder (the results are saved beside the audio)
str_the_station_user_cannot_read_help: The station user cannot read this folder
str_the_stations_address_tap_help: The station's address: tap BirdSuite (once connected), then Connected devices and the Info button (top right).
str_the_stations_clips_kept_a_day_help: The station's clips kept a day (species x clips a day per species)
str_the_stations_disk_or_a_network_help: the station's disk or a network share, as far as the station user may read it; the results are saved in the folder, beside the audio
str_the_stations_microphone_shared: the station's, shared with the analysis
str_the_stations_normal_recording_help: The station's normal recording for the analysis goes on either way.
str_the_sum_of_the_species_is_help: The sum of the species is scaled from the species seen to the species identified.
str_the_system_journal_is_cut_to_help: The system journal is cut to the days chosen and 200 MB, and the old rotated log files are removed. Export them first to keep a copy.
str_the_test_was_not_confirmed_yet: The test was not confirmed yet.
str_the_timezone_and_the_species_help: The timezone and the species list are defined per location in {menu:Locations}.
str_the_web_password_is_kept_only_help: The web password is kept only in coded form, so type the one the new stations will have (empty = the factory password birdsuite). The file may hold passwords: keep it private.
str_the_wifi_password_also_printed_help: The WiFi password also printed as text
str_then_go_back_and_pick_the_help: Then go back and pick the groups again.
str_these_limits_delete_only_the_help: These limits delete only the sound; the detection keeps counting.
str_they_leave_every_page_and_help: They leave every page and statistic and can be restored here until purged (Purge Removed).
str_this_session_is_still_recording: This session is still recording: stop it first
str_this_stations_own_mail_server_help: this station's own mail server (localhost:{port}, set up by the system)
str_to_locate_the_station_when_help: To locate the station when there is more than one nearby.
str_turn_it_on_and_follow_googles_help: Turn it on and follow Google's steps (a code by SMS or the Google app).
str_turn_the_station_on_or_take_it_help: Turn the station on, or take it away from its networks, and wait 1 minute.
str_type_a_name_e_g_birdsuite_and_help: Type a name, e.g. BirdSuite, and press Create.
str_type_a_new_token_only_to_help: Type a new token only to replace it.
str_untick_only_the_next_one_then_help: untick = only the next one, then off
str_until_purge_removed_it_can_be_help: Until Purge Removed it can be restored; after that it is gone for good.
str_up_to_the_last_90_days_one_help: Up to the last 90 days, one point a day, measured right after the nightly purge.
str_use_a_bot_only_for_the_station_help: Use a bot only for the station: another program reading the same bot keeps the station from seeing the groups.
str_use_the_16_letter_app_password_help: Use the 16-letter app password, not the account password.
str_used_on_this_disk_at_the_peak_help: Used on this disk at the peak (held by the ceiling)
str_wait_a_minute_and_look_in_the_help: Wait a minute and look in the spam folder.
str_waiting_for_the_groups_each_help: Waiting for the groups: each group appears here as soon as the bot is in it.
str_when_a_known_network_is_in_help: When a known network is in range again, the station goes back to it and turns its WiFi off (not while a phone is connected).
str_when_one_of_them_is_in_range_help: When one of them is in range, the station WiFi turns off and the station joins it within seconds.
str_where_do_i_find_the_name_and_help: Where do I find the name and password?
str_where_new_detections_are_filed_help: where new detections are filed (the station's coordinates)
str_which_e_mail_account_will_send_help: Which e-mail account will send the notifications?
str_while_it_is_on_the_station_help: While it is on, the station leaves your WiFi network (on a cable it keeps working).
str_while_the_station_wifi_is_on_help: While the station WiFi is on and no phone is on it, the station looks for its WiFi networks and the phone hotspot every minute.
str_with_a_phone_on_the_station_help: With a phone on the station WiFi it does not look until the phone leaves; with the cable connected the WiFi stays off.
str_with_more_than_one_station_use_help: With more than one station, use this plan: they all join the same hotspot, each with its own address, and the station switch at the top goes from one to the other.
str_with_no_network_cable_wifi_or_help: With no network (cable, WiFi or phone hotspot) the station opens its own WiFi, as the mode below says.
str_with_the_cable_unplugged_the_help: With the cable unplugged, the station first tries its networks in range; the station WiFi comes only when none of them takes it.
str_with_this_stations_phone_hotspot: With this station's phone hotspot (name and password)
str_with_this_stations_wifi_password: With this station's WiFi password (the new stations get the same one)
str_without_internet_and_help: Without internet the notifications wait and go out when the station is online.
str_without_internet_in_a_help: Without internet the notifications wait in a queue and go out when the station is online again.
str_without_internet_the_station_help: Without internet, the station takes the time from the phone:
str_yahoo_icloud_zoho_or_any_smtp_help: Yahoo, iCloud, Zoho or any SMTP server.
str_yahoo_needs_an_app_password_help: Yahoo needs an app password (Account Security › Generate app password).
str_you_must_analyse_or_import_help: You must be authenticated to analyse or import files.
str_you_must_change_the_current_help: You must be authenticated to change the current location.
str_you_must_change_the_database_help: You must be authenticated to change the database.
str_you_must_change_the_e_help: You must be authenticated to change the e-mail settings.
str_you_must_change_the_location_data_he: You must be authenticated to change the location data.
str_you_must_change_the_location_help: You must be authenticated to change the location.
str_you_must_change_the_locations_help: You must be authenticated to change the locations.
str_you_must_change_the_network_help: You must be authenticated to change the network.
str_you_must_change_the_stations_help: You must be authenticated to change the stations.
str_you_must_change_the_telegram_help: You must be authenticated to change the Telegram settings.
str_you_must_control_the_analysis_help: You must be authenticated to control the analysis.
str_you_must_control_the_job_help: You must be authenticated to control the job.
str_you_must_download_the_database_help: You must be authenticated to download the database.
str_you_must_manage_the_logs_help: You must be authenticated to manage the logs.
str_you_must_print_the_label_help: You must be authenticated to print the label (it shows the WiFi password).
str_you_must_stop_the_recording_help: You must be authenticated to stop the recording.
str_zoho_an_application_specific_help: Zoho: an application-specific password when 2-factor is on.
